title: This Gold Stock Surged 400% While Gold Fell, Here's How
speaker: Byron Coulthard (CEO, BRS Resources)

macro_themes.view: We are at the beginning of a commodity super cycle and metals prices are more likely to rise than fall.
Silver demand from AI data centers, EVs and electronics leaves a 46.3 million oz shortfall for 2026.
Junior miners offer more upside than bullion as resources are proven, if downside risk is managed.

calls.reason: Commodity super cycle and demand; doesn't foresee gold going lower, though plans conservatively at $3,200. Cites panelists calling $7,000 by 2030 (not his own target).
calls.quote: I don't foresee the price of copper, gold, silver, uh, going lower. If anything, I see with demand... it's all going to go higher.

calls.reason: Structural silver deficit (46.3M oz shortage in 2026) from AI data centers, EVs and electronics.
calls.quote: Silver is in high demand, as we all know, with AI data centers, EV, electronics.

calls.reason: Part of a commodity super cycle; expects copper with gold and silver to go higher on demand.
calls.quote: I don't foresee the price of copper, gold, silver, uh, going lower.

notes: Paid/sponsored interview ('disseminated on behalf of BRS Resources'); guest is the CEO promoting his own stock, so the BRS stock itself is not recorded as a call (ticker not given). Video says gold is down this year at ~$4,100.
